elements.title: Science Fiction Chronicle (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the magazine Science Fiction Chronicle changed its name to just Chronicle two decades after its launch, to avoid being confused with the San Francisco Chronicle?

elements.title: Darren Moore (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that football manager Darren Moore led Sheffield Wednesday to promotion even after they lost the first leg of their play-off semi-final 4–0?

elements.contents: ... that some locals have criticised the flag of Kagoshima Prefecture, which is supposed to depict the prefecture's topography but omits its outlying islands?

elements.title: Richard Davis (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Hopewell Baptist Church (Wikipedia — did you know?)
